name: Home page shows the brand, services and roadmap
description: Verifies the page presents Synthetic Talent with its three services and four roadmap stages.
expected: The Synthetic Talent name, TikTok, YouTube and Instagram, the three service cards (AI influencer management, Content management, Creator management tool) and the Now, Next, Then and Long term roadmap stages are visible.

name: Navigation and footer links reach the team, privacy and terms
description: Verifies the header link reaches the team list and the footer links reach the legal sections.
expected: The Team section shows Victor Boateng as Founder, then the Privacy policy section is shown, then the Terms of use section is shown.

name: Page reads cleanly on a phone
description: Verifies the layout stacks on a small screen without sideways scrolling.
steps: Scroll through the What we do and Roadmap sections
expected: The service cards are stacked in one column, the roadmap stages are readable, and the page has no horizontal scroll.
